records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our acquisition of Inertial Labs contributed $18.7 million of net revenue in the first quarter of fiscal 2026.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the NSE business grew year-over-year as a result of strong demand for lab and production and field products driven by the data center ecosystem as well as growth in aerospace and defense products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was primarily driven by the increase in amortization of intangibles and amortization of acquisition related inventory step-up, partially offset by higher volume and favorable product mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amortization of acquired technologies within Cost of revenues increased $3.6 million or 109.1% during the three months ended September 27, 2025 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended September 27, 2025, Cash provided by operating activities was $31.0 million, consisting of net loss of $21.4 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g., depreciation, amortization, stock-based compensation and other non-cash items) totaling $62.3 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that used $9.9 million.
